ReviewCondition.description:
Which of the three review conditions described in
docs/local-validation-protocol.md ("Review conditions") a given `ReviewEvent` was
collected under. Full retrieved evidence is available in every condition -- what
varies is only whether/what risk-event tooling was shown, never the underlying
evidence content.
ReviewCondition.title: ReviewCondition

ReviewerAction.description:
The bounded set of actions a reviewer may take on a risk event or trace in a
local-validation study (docs/local-validation-protocol.md). Never a forced
binary correct/incorrect judgment.
ReviewerAction.title: ReviewerAction

displayed_risk_event_ids.description: Every risk_event_id shown to the reviewer during this event.
displayed_risk_event_ids.title: Displayed Risk Event Ids

experience_measures.description: Optional ad hoc experience measures for this event, named per docs/reviewer-measures.md where applicable -- not a fixed schema, since a review condition may collect only a subset.
experience_measures.title: Experience Measures

opened_evidence_item_ids.description: ContextItem item_ids the reviewer actually opened/inspected.
opened_evidence_item_ids.title: Opened Evidence Item Ids

reviewer_id.description: Caller-supplied, opaque reviewer identifier -- not authenticated.
reviewer_id.title: Reviewer Id

target_claim_id.description: Which answer claim this action applies to, if any.
target_claim_id.title: Target Claim Id

target_risk_event_id.description: Which risk event this action applies to, if any.
target_risk_event_id.title: Target Risk Event Id
